body.title: 200% organic growth with sub-second load times
body.summary: We partnered with DrDoor to create a high-performance, SEO-first website that strengthened their digital presence in India. The result: faster load times, better conversions and a scalable foundation for long-term growth.

content.text: DrDoor had a legacy website that lacked speed, structure and SEO foundation. Despite offering high-quality FRP door solutions, their digital platform failed to reflect their market leadership and was missing visibility in India search results.

body.challenge: DrDoor faced low organic visibility, long page load times, an unoptimised UI/UX with no clear conversion funnel, no CMS for content updates and poor mobile performance.

content.text: We completely redesigned DrDoor's digital ecosystem, focusing on
Built a high-speed, CMS-driven web platform that allows DrDoor to manage pages easily.
Integrated AI tools for keyword mapping, structured metadata and local search targeting.
Structured metadata, local search targeting and content optimised for manufacturing enquiries across India.
Implemented contact workflows and real-time analytics dashboards for lead tracking.

body.outcome: Within three months, DrDoor achieved 200% organic traffic growth, received qualified manufacturing enquiries and strengthened brand credibility with a fast, modern website that ranks better across India search results.
body.technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Storyblok, Mailjet, Google Analytics, SEO Tools, Vercel
